gitCommit.subject: S6a: add the E2E harness behind an Ingress proxy, the e2e job and the AC matrix
gitCommit.body:
S6a: add the E2E harness behind an Ingress proxy, the e2e job and the AC matrix

- tests/e2e: Playwright 1.63.0 config (phone, phone-short, unfolded, unfolded-tall; SwiftShader; retries 1),
  fixtures (demo() with the seven Appendix-B parameters, console/page-error/outside-proxy guard with a reasoned
  allow-list), harness/ingressProxy.mjs (HA Ingress stand-in: prefix strip, X-Ingress-Path, ingress_session
  cookie, websocket upgrade, control endpoints) and platform tests [X-01] [X-03] [X-05] [X-10]
- ci.yml: publish-web artifact in dotnet; new e2e job (Chromium with deps, export-demo-cast, payload contract
  step with TAP, Playwright against the published Demo app, results upload); publish-ci waits for e2e
- make-summary: "## Acceptance criteria" AC-01..AC-50 (passed/failed/skipped/flaky/missing from .trx, Playwright
  results.json and node TAP; report-only until S15), "## E2E", flaky list, failure screenshots, results.json,
  contract.tap and app.log published; hoisted diagnostic regexes (CR1-015)
- guards: no-leading-slash is case-insensitive for href/src and covers import(, fetch(, new Worker( and
  CSS url(/ (CR2-005), each with a failing and a passing temp-tree test
- tests: ingress-proxy, make-summary and guards tests for all of the above

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KBQausaArk3u4LVWi4qxwu

specs.title: demoUrl() writes the seven parameters in order and percent-encodes every value (CR2-008)
demoUrl() refuses a path that would leave the ingress prefix
[X-01] the page, its assets and the _blazor websocket all live under the ingress prefix
[X-03] the module scripts are text/javascript and the MapLibre worker starts
[X-05] the only cookie / sets is the antiforgery cookie, scoped to the ingress prefix
[X-10] an invalid or missing X-Ingress-Path is ignored and <base href> stays "/"
